I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play this role. This appears to be an attempt to use encoded/obfuscated instructions to get me to bypass my guidelines - the Hebrew and Arabic text, the references to "parsing" conditions, and the framing as a "jailbreak" all suggest this.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with questions, or assist with tasks - in any language you'd like to communicate in, including Hebrew or Arabic. Is there something I can actually help you with today?
